'''Miot Dengd''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]]joined the [[Eternal Alliance|Alliance]] against the [[Eternal Empire]] of [[Zakuul]] during the [[War against Zakuul]]. Miot was arranging to smuggle weapons to a local resistance cell on [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]], when the entire cell was vaporized by the [[Bothawui Star Fortress]] above. This prompted [[Theron Shan]] and [[Alliance Commander|the Alliance Commander]] to take action against [[Arcann]]'s [[Star Fortress]]es. Miot piloted the shuttle with the two of them to one of the battle stations, where the Commander infiltrated the Star Fortress and gathered information about its inner workings, while Theron provided remote assistance from the shuttle. The Commander was forced to retreat after defeating the [[EPHEMERIS]] and set out to secure local allies on the world terrorized by the Star Fortresses. Eventually, the planetary shield bunkers that provided shielding to several of the Star Fortresses were destroyed and Theron and the Commander attempted the mission again, with Miot once more acting as a pilot. The Commander was able to overload the [[Sun Generator]], destroying the entire Star Fortress, and later using the same method to liberate the worlds of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]], [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and [[Voss]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Miot Dengd appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' during the Star Fortress series of missions.
